articles.title: Canva releases its first image generation model - TechCrunch
articles.description: Canva is making its new image model available to all users, promising better, more customizable performance at lower costs.
articles.content:
Design platform Canva released its first image generation model, called Canva Craft, developed by its research team to compete with same-category models from Google, OpenAI, ByteDance, and Meta.
